care.sun: Partial shade (~25% shade); filtered light; avoid deep shade for productivity
care.water: High; keep soil moisture nearly year-round with good drainage; avoid drought and waterlogging
care.growth: Small to medium tropical understory tree
care.size: About 7.6–9.1 m in tropical conditions; often kept lower (6–8 ft) in home landscapes
care.guide: Understory tropical tree needing heat, high humidity, frost-free conditions, partial shade, wind protection, and steady soil moisture with drainage. Sensitive to freezes and prolonged cool weather.

plants.climateLabel: Hot humid tropical; high frost sensitivity

climateTraits.floweringRequirements: Cauliflorous flowering on older wood; flowering only when temperatures are at or above 68°F (20°C). Drought stress causes flower drop.
climateTraits.fruitingRequirements: Produces pods (drupes); flower to mature pod typically 5–7 months. Needs near year-round soil moisture; drought causes poor fruit production. Pollination may require compatible varieties or hand pollination where midges are absent.
climateTraits.survivalVsThriveNotes: Reliable outdoor survival and productivity need hot, humid, frost-free tropical conditions with steady moisture. Warm subtropical sites can be marginal; brief freezes or prolonged cool periods may damage or kill plants. Frost-free alone is not sufficient without humidity/moisture fit.

warnings: Highly sensitive to frost and prolonged cool temperatures
Needs high humidity / humid tropical moisture regime
Does not tolerate windy exposure
